_comment: Justified divergences between the `just check` target list and .github/workflows/ci.yml job names. Every entry MUST carry a non-empty reason; false records a known, deliberate omission.

divergences.name: check-ci-parity
divergences.reason: This is the janitor/local aggregate guard introduced by livespec-console-beads-fabro-ccycuk. It reads CI's committed workflow but this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: check-e2e-tmux
divergences.reason: Deliberately CI-only for this slice. Whether to promote it into `just check` belongs to the sibling measurement slice named in livespec-console-beads-fabro-ccycuk.

divergences.name: check-fork-drift
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate because its upstream lane depends on installed orchestrator plugin state that CI does not provision; the gate itself prints a loud skip when that lane cannot resolve.

divergences.name: check-spec-governance-default-block
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate as a hermetic spec-governance guard; CI's matrix predates this target and this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: ci-green
divergences.reason: Aggregate branch-protection rollup job, not an executable check target.
